_readme: Attach both servers. OpenSEO = official hosted MCP (OAuth via `codex mcp login openseo`, or API key from app.openseo.so/settings). Preferred: `codex plugin marketplace add every-app/open-seo && codex plugin add openseo@openseo && codex mcp login openseo` - that bundles MCP + all 12 skills.
_key_notes: export OPENSEO_API_KEY=oseo_... ; for headless/CI use --bearer-token-env-var OPENSEO_API_KEY
_selfhost: Cloudflare Workers (free, documented) or Docker - NOT Vercel. See seoforge CLI: openseo-selfhost. Then set mcp_servers.openseo.url to https://your-worker.workers.dev/mcp
